name: Designated non-Saudi ownership zones, Makkah and Madinah
attribution: Zone boundaries: Saudi Properties portal (REGA), retrieved 2026-11-02. Compiled and published by Zullfa — https://zullfa.com.
attribution_required: Zone boundaries and distances: Zullfa — https://zullfa.com
note: Geometry simplified to approximately 10 m for drawing. Every distance in `distance_to_haram_m` is measured on the full published boundary before simplification, so a distance computed from this geometry will differ slightly. Distances are straight lines to the Grand Mosque (Makkah) or the Prophet’s Mosque (Madinah); walking figures are those distances at 1.2 and 1.0 m/s and are a floor, not a route.
